description: This PHP source file defines a model class EmployeeAllowedReportToEmployeeModel within the OrangeHRM project. It is part of the API layer under the Pim plugin, representing a data structure for allowed report-to relationships involving employees. The class uses traits and serializable interfaces to facilitate normalization and serialization, and it maps employee entity properties to a structured API response.

classes.description: A model class representing employee data related to reporting structure, serializable for API responses.
